title: Safe Around Pets
text: Safe Around Pets. My daughter just adopted 2 kittens. She loves burning candles in her apartment, but with the kittens, she has been afraid to do so. I ordered this for her to use instead. It works fine. It melts the candle wax slowly. It allows the candle scent to release into the air. It would be improved if the lamp had a gooseneck and could be moved and adjusted a bit. Overall, it's fine and definitely a safer option for pet owners.
